cd /workspace/submission && cat > NOTES.md <<'EOF'
# Certified sharing replay - implementation notes

Entry point: `python3 submission/main.py` (one JSON request on stdin to EOF, one
JSON response on stdout).  Only `protocol.py` (whole-request validation) and
`te/` (replay) are needed; NumPy is the bundled CPU dependency.

## Pipeline (`te/session.py`)

* `CaseSession` owns one case: cumulative `c/d/paths/mode`, the retained `rho`,
  the fixed `alpha = a/b`, the generation counter and the transport registry.
* `configure` patches atomically, keeps rho, then resets round/cache/barrier and
  opens a new generation.  A `PathProvider` slot is replaced in place, so null
  slots stay holes and repaired slots keep their identity.
* `issue` snapshots `c,d,paths,mode,rho`, the owned ids, the generation and the
  normalized signed bias `B[w,e] = A[w,e]/c[e] + (z-X-u)/W` (zero on withdrawn
  edges) and solves the worker problem immediately; the proposal is immutable.
* `deliver` classifies with the protocol's fixed precedence
  duplicate > obsolete > superseded > infeasible > accepted, always recording a
  receipt.  Only acceptance replaces the owned amounts, the worker load row, the
  latest accepted sequence, the seen/fresh flags and the acceptance round.
* `step` advances only through `PartialBarrier.can_advance()` (all seen, at least
  `quorum` fresh, no seen age beyond `max_lag`); a blocked step reports the
  missing/stale/fresh sets and mutates nothing.  An advance runs the controller,
  increments the round and clears freshness while caches and ages persist.
* `retune` rescales the SCALED dual so `rho*u` is invariant; `save`/`restore`
  move the complete algorithm state across a generation boundary (tickets,
  proposals, receipts and checkpoints never roll back).

## Certificates

* Worker (`distributed/worker.py`): amounts, never fractions.  Accelerated
  projected gradient (bounded `1/L` step with `L = lambda_max(H)`, FISTA
  momentum) identifies the optimal support, then a primal/dual active-set polish
  solves the reduced KKT system exactly.  Potentials are `-min G` over the
  available positive-demand slots (0 when a group carries no traffic), which
  makes `G + lambda >= 0` exact and the tangent gap `f - D` a sum of
  `x * (G - min G)` terms.  Nothing is returned before `check()` re-derives f,
  G, D and the feasibility constraints inside 1e-10.
* Controller (`mlu_backends/pdlp_mlu.py`): closed-form water filling for the
  route ceiling, projection at 1 for admit; `z = min(h, V)`, `t = rho*(V-z)` with
  the tiny summation residual folded into one pressure entry so that
  `h*(1 - sum t)` stays inside the absolute tolerance.  Withdrawn edges are
  pinned to exactly zero everywhere.
EOF
